scope: Packaging integrity guards only; no mathematical source or theorem statement changes
findings_repaired: Reproducer previously skipped verification when SOURCE_MANIFEST.json was missing
Manifest entry removal could hide a changed exact-statement wrapper
Manifest source archive metadata was not fixed to the audited source identity
Archive builder could package a corrupted checksum list
repairs: Both entry points use one fail-closed validator before Lean, downloads or archive writes
Manifest and checksum list are mandatory; schema, metadata, paths, duplicate keys and digests are strict
The independently embedded exact payload inventory covers every source, wrapper, script and report
Actual source files, manifest entries and checksum rows must have exact cross-coverage
SHA256SUMS must match the complete canonical digest list, including SOURCE_MANIFEST.json
Only documented top-level runtime/VCS directories are excluded
Normal and Python -O negative regressions execute both production entry points
Shared immutable-source and preserved-wrapper checks reject changed proof/pins/statements even after outer manifests/checksums are regenerated
authenticity_boundary: External trusted archive digest or repository commit; internal unkeyed hashes do not authenticate a fully self-consistently rewritten package.
